Title: Login with valid credentials
Test_Steps: 1. Open app.vwo.com; 2. Enter valid email; 3. Enter valid password; 4. Click Sign In
Expected_Result: User authenticated and redirected to dashboard within 2s

Title: Login with invalid password
Test_Steps: 1. Open login; 2. Enter valid email; 3. Enter wrong password; 4. Submit
Expected_Result: Inline error shown; access denied; no session token issued

Title: Login field boundary - empty submit
Test_Steps: 1. Leave email and password blank; 2. Click Sign In
Expected_Result: Validation errors on both fields; form not submitted

Title: Email format validation
Test_Steps: 1. Enter malformed email; 2. Enter any password; 3. Submit
Expected_Result: Email-format validation error; submission blocked

Title: 2FA challenge enforced
Test_Steps: 1. Login with valid creds; 2. Observe 2FA prompt; 3. Enter valid OTP
Expected_Result: 2FA code required before dashboard access; valid OTP grants entry

Title: Session timeout / re-auth
Test_Steps: 1. Login; 2. Idle beyond session TTL; 3. Attempt protected action
Expected_Result: Session expired; user redirected to login; action blocked

Title: Analyst role cannot edit experiment
Test_Steps: 1. Login as analyst; 2. Open an experiment; 3. Attempt to edit variation
Expected_Result: Edit controls hidden/disabled; unauthorized API call returns 403

Title: Create A/B test with two variations
Test_Steps: 1. New > A/B Test; 2. Enter URL; 3. Add Variation B; 4. Save
Expected_Result: Experiment created in draft with Control + Variation B

Title: Create Split URL test
Test_Steps: 1. New > Split URL; 2. Add control and variant URLs; 3. Save
Expected_Result: Split URL test created with both destinations registered

Title: Create Multivariate test with multiple sections
Test_Steps: 1. New > Multivariate; 2. Define 2 sections x 2 variants; 3. Save
Expected_Result: MVT created; 4 combinations generated

Title: Reject experiment with zero variations
Test_Steps: 1. Create experiment; 2. Remove all variations; 3. Attempt launch
Expected_Result: Launch blocked; validation requires >=1 variation

Title: Define custom goal / metric
Test_Steps: 1. Open Goals; 2. Add conversion goal (click); 3. Map element; 4. Save
Expected_Result: Goal saved and linked to experiment KPIs

Title: Schedule experiment start/end
Test_Steps: 1. Open Schedule; 2. Set future start and end; 3. Save
Expected_Result: Schedule persisted; experiment auto-activates at start

Title: Visual editor edits element text
Test_Steps: 1. Open visual editor; 2. Select heading; 3. Change text; 4. Save
Expected_Result: Text change applied and previewable in variation

Title: Code editor injects custom JS/CSS
Test_Steps: 1. Open code editor; 2. Add CSS override; 3. Save; 4. Preview
Expected_Result: Custom code applied; preview reflects change

Title: Preview across device viewports
Test_Steps: 1. Open preview; 2. Toggle desktop/tablet/mobile
Expected_Result: Variation renders correctly per viewport

Title: Results show statistical confidence
Test_Steps: 1. Open Reports; 2. View SmartStats; 3. Read probability-to-beat-baseline
Expected_Result: Confidence/probability metric displayed; winner flagged at threshold

Title: Insufficient data state handled
Test_Steps: 1. Open Reports immediately after launch
Expected_Result: Reports show 'insufficient data' state; no false winner

Title: Generate click heatmap
Test_Steps: 1. Open Insights; 2. Select page; 3. Generate click heatmap
Expected_Result: Heatmap renders click density overlay

Title: Capture and replay session recording
Test_Steps: 1. Open Recordings; 2. Select session; 3. Play
Expected_Result: Recording replays user interactions accurately

Title: Funnel drop-off analytics
Test_Steps: 1. Open Funnels; 2. Define 3-step funnel; 3. View report
Expected_Result: Drop-off percentages shown per step

Title: On-page survey creation
Test_Steps: 1. New survey; 2. Add question; 3. Target page; 4. Publish
Expected_Result: Survey published and renders on target page

Title: Audience segment by geography
Test_Steps: 1. Open Targeting; 2. Add geo = India; 3. Save
Expected_Result: Experiment serves only to matching geo segment

Title: Segment by behavior attribute
Test_Steps: 1. Targeting; 2. Add returning-visitor condition; 3. Save
Expected_Result: Targeting rule saved; serving restricted to segment

Title: Real-time dashboard refresh
Test_Steps: 1. Open dashboard; 2. Generate conversions; 3. Observe update
Expected_Result: Metrics update in near real-time without manual reload

Title: Export report data
Test_Steps: 1. Open report; 2. Click Export; 3. Choose CSV
Expected_Result: Report downloaded as CSV with correct metrics

Title: Deliver personalized content to segment
Test_Steps: 1. Create campaign; 2. Target segment; 3. Set content; 4. Activate
Expected_Result: Matching users see personalized content; others see default

Title: Sync goal data to Google Analytics
Test_Steps: 1. Enable GA connector; 2. Run experiment; 3. Verify GA dimension
Expected_Result: Experiment data appears as GA custom dimension

Title: Mixpanel event forwarding
Test_Steps: 1. Enable Mixpanel; 2. Trigger goal; 3. Check Mixpanel
Expected_Result: Goal event forwarded to Mixpanel with correct payload

Title: Connector auth failure handling
Test_Steps: 1. Configure connector with bad token; 2. Save; 3. Trigger sync
Expected_Result: Graceful error surfaced; no data leak; sync retried/failed safely

Title: Create Kanban experiment backlog card
Test_Steps: 1. Open Plan board; 2. Add idea card; 3. Move to In-Progress
Expected_Result: Card created and moves across Kanban columns

Title: Login page WCAG 2.1 AA scan
Test_Steps: 1. Run axe scan on login; 2. Review violations
Expected_Result: No critical/serious AA violations; labels and contrast pass

Title: Keyboard-only navigation of dashboard
Test_Steps: 1. Tab through dashboard; 2. Activate controls via keyboard
Expected_Result: All interactive elements reachable and operable; visible focus

Title: Editor controls have ARIA labels
Test_Steps: 1. Inspect editor toolbar; 2. Verify aria-labels/roles
Expected_Result: Toolbar controls expose accessible names and roles

Title: Critical-path smoke after release
Test_Steps: 1. Login; 2. Create A/B test; 3. Launch; 4. View report; 5. Logout
Expected_Result: All critical-path steps pass; no regression in core flow
